Validate Client Credentials:
SELECT client_id, client_secret, user_id FROM api_clients
WHERE client_id = :clientId AND client_secret = :clientSecret
Store Token in DB:
INSERT INTO api_clients (client_id, client_secret, access_token, expires_at, callback_url)
VALUES (:clientId, :clientSecret, :accessToken, :expiresAt, :callbackUrl)
ON CONFLICT (client_id) DO UPDATE SET
  access_token = :accessToken,
  expires_at = :expiresAt,
  callback_url = :callbackUrl
Retrieve Token from DB:
SELECT access_token, expires_at, client_id FROM api_clients
WHERE access_token = :token AND expires_at > :currentTime
Check User Exists:
SELECT username, email FROM users
WHERE username = :username OR email = :email
Insert New User:
INSERT INTO users (username, email, first_name, last_name, password_hash)
VALUES (:username, :email, :firstName, :lastName, :passwordHash)
Validate User Credentials:
SELECT user_id, username, email, first_name, last_name FROM users
WHERE username = :username AND password_hash = :passwordHash AND is_active = true
Check Existing API Client: SELECT client_id, client_secret FROM api_clients WHERE user_id = :userId
Create API Client:
INSERT INTO api_clients (client_id, client_secret, user_id, salesforce_user_id, is_active)
VALUES (:clientId, :clientSecret, :userId, :salesforceUserId, true)
Update Token in DB:
UPDATE api_clients SET 
  access_token = :accessToken, 
  expires_at = :expiresAt,
  token_expires_at = :tokenExpiresAt,
  refresh_token = :refreshToken,
  refresh_token_expires_at = :refreshExpiresAt,
  salesforce_user_id = :salesforceUserId,
  is_active = true,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE client_id = :clientId
Validate Refresh Token:
SELECT client_id, access_token, refresh_token, refresh_token_expires_at, salesforce_user_id, is_active
FROM api_clients
WHERE refresh_token = :refreshToken AND refresh_token_expires_at > :currentTime AND is_active = true
Update Tokens:
UPDATE api_clients SET 
  access_token = :newAccessToken,
  expires_at = :tokenExpiresAt,
  token_expires_at = :tokenExpiresAt,
  refresh_token = :newRefreshToken,
  refresh_token_expires_at = :refreshExpiresAt,
  updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE client_id = :clientId
Deactivate User Connection:
UPDATE api_clients 
SET is_active = false, 
    updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE salesforce_user_id = :salesforceUserId 
  AND client_id = :clientId 
  AND is_active = true
Select Employee Goals: SELECT goal FROM employee_goals WHERE employee_id = :employeeId
Select Learning Status: SELECT course, status FROM employee_learning WHERE employee_id = :employeeId
Select Next Pay Date: SELECT next_pay_date FROM employee_pto WHERE employee_id = :employeeId
Select PTO Balance: SELECT pto_balance FROM employee_pto WHERE employee_id = :employeeId
Insert or Update PTO Schedule:
INSERT INTO employee_pto (employee_id, next_pay_date)
VALUES (:employeeId, :endDate)
ON CONFLICT (employee_id) DO UPDATE SET
next_pay_date = :endDate
